findings: All41 shipped inline examples pass, while standalone filter transforms three synthetic failure-shaped inputs for uv sync, mypy and rsync into up-to-date/no-issues/transfer-complete claims with exit0. The filter API has no producer exit-status input.

Actual wrap with owned stand-in uv exiting7 retains exit7 in all four controls. Forced-small compression and default16-line input nevertheless drop the failure diagnostic and print environment already up to date; neither retains original content in blob storage.

Default one-line input passes the original failure through. Default201-line input enters summary behavior, preserves the error inline and stashes the full output. These positive controls bound the failure, rather than implying universal wrapper loss.

The16-line control lies below the default retrieve_min_lines40 and below huge-output summarization, with enough reduction to clear net-win gating. A generic successful on_empty message is not evidence that the producer succeeded.
Owned producer invocation markers verify the fake uv executable was used; no installed package tool, network or installation was invoked.
harness_note: Initial owned assertion assumed wrap would preserve the diagnostic. Actual exit7 with a successful-looking summary contradicted that assumption; harness expanded to explicit forced-small/default-small/default16/default201 cases and preserved observed results. Original code/tests unchanged.
transfer_decision: Do not use on-empty text as a success verdict or adopt output filtering into file identity. Preserve operation status, diagnostics and recoverability as separate facts. No foreign production source copied.
limits: Four finite wrapper cases and237 focused tests do not qualify every output shape, configuration, host or package tool.
Wrap/config sources remain partial. Tests use an owned producer, not real uv dependency resolution.
No rrrah code changes this turn. Native pHash.org/ASAN remains skipped.
